summary: GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next serve the reorganized QAD checkpoints, whose vision towers are stored quantized
compatibility: No user action required. The presets download the new revisions once (about 178 GB and 102 GB); the decoder weights are unchanged.
details: GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-MXFP8-CSF-QAD@dec48abd and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4-MXFP8-CSF-QAD@dc5b8ab2 use the Hugging Face layout: config.json recipes mark the CSF expert scales, and vLLM reads the snapshot directly, without a serving directory.
Their vision towers use MXFP8 attention and W4A16 NVFP4 MLPs from the checkpoint; glm53-tp2 no longer quantizes the tower to MXFP8 while loading.
TP2 on RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q: glm53-tp2 1,844,162 KV tokens, vision checks 11/11, 220-226 tok/s on a coding prompt; qwen38-tp2 5,065,660 KV tokens, 10/11, 297-309 tok/s; no CJK leakage.
